text:
ڈنڈے وچ ٹکا،
بد بخیل نوں دھکا،
شوم دی چھاتی،
سخی دا دروازہ۔
romanized:
Ḍanḍe vichch ṭikkā,
Bad bakhīl nūṅ dhikkā,
Shūm dī chhātī,
Sakhī dā darwāza.
literal_en:
A tick on the pestle,
A shove to the miser.
Sit on the miser's chest (to punish him).
And at the generous man's door (to demand bhang).

source.book: Grammar and Dictionary of Western Panjabi, as spoken in the Shahpur District, with Proverbs, Sayings and Verses
